overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The contract terms were agreed in a January 23, 2013 executive session, and later typing of the draft by a non-member staffer sent to one selectman was permissible.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a properly posted meeting about the police chief's contract, which was executed at a May 8, 2013 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find evidence to support the allegation that a quorum of the Board improperly deliberated about the draft contract between its meetings held on January 23, 2013 and May 8, 2013.
